title: Key Path Identification for Resolving Knowledge Conflicts via SAE-based Steering
abstract: arXiv:2609.08173v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse autoencoder (SAE)-based steering has been widely used to address knowledge conflicts by guiding LLMs to be more faithful to the contextual knowledge. Existing methods usually perform mass steering, which modifies a large batch of SAE features identified via correlation-based methods. However, due to the inaccurate correlation and the neglected feature interactions, mass steering methods fail to precisely identify the features that play the key roles in steering and introduce a large number of redundant ones, which add noise and weaken the steering effects. Our empirical studies reveal that steering only a small subset of the identified features can achieve comparable or even better performance. Motivated by this finding, we propose Key Path Identification (KPI), a novel method that identifies key steering features characterized by strong causal dependencies with both upstream and downstream features. translated_title: 基于SAE导向的知识冲突解决关键路径识别
translated_abstract: 基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的导向方法已被广泛用于解决知识冲突问题，其通过引导大语言模型（LLM）更加忠实于上下文知识。现有方法通常执行大规模导向，即修改通过基于相关性方法识别出的一大批SAE特征。然而，由于相关性不准确以及忽视了特征间的交互作用，大规模导向方法无法精确识别在导向中起关键作用的特征，并引入了大量冗余特征，这些冗余特征会增加噪声并削弱导向效果。我们的实证研究表明，仅对所识别特征中的一小部分进行导向，就能取得相当甚至更好的性能。受此发现启发，我们提出了关键路径识别（KPI），这是一种新颖的方法，用于识别与上游和下游特征均具有强因果依赖关系的关键导向特征。基于这些特征，KPI构建……（摘要不完整，原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出关键路径识别（KPI）方法，通过识别与上下游特征具有强因果依赖关系的关键SAE特征，仅对少量关键特征进行导向即可解决大语言模型的知识冲突问题，避免冗余特征的噪声干扰并增强导向效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes Key Path Identification (KPI), a novel method that identifies key SAE steering features with strong causal dependencies on both upstream and downstream features, enabling more precise and effective knowledge conflict resolution in LLMs by steering only a small subset of features.
